overview: Farming is unlocked via the 'Planting' Memetic Specialization in the Logistics/Management tree. Seeds are obtained by harvesting wild plants (or from growing your own crop). Plant seeds in loamy soil or a Planter Box, water with Boiled or Pure Water (Dirty Water lowers crop Vitality), and provide light — Irrigation Systems and Grow Lights can automate this. Harvest by interacting once growth reaches 100%. Deviated (mutated) Crops can drop from regular ones and are used in special high-value recipes.
howToFarm: Gather seeds from wild plants or from harvested crops.
Plant in loamy soil or a Planter Box.
Water with Boiled/Pure Water and ensure adequate light.
Harvest at 100% growth for the crop plus a chance at bonus seeds or a Deviated (mutated) variant.
